question: 본체에서 소음이 너무 심한데 원인이 뭐야?
지금 품절 안 된 램만 보여줘
비싼 거 보여줘
sql: SELECT m.module_id, m.category_id, m.name, m.brand, m.price, m.performance_score, m.image_url FROM modules m ORDER BY m.price DESC

question: 50만원 이하 그래픽카드를 VRAM 큰 순서로 보여줘
sql: SELECT m.*, g.memory_capacity FROM modules m JOIN graphic_cards g ON g.module_id = m.module_id WHERE m.price <= 500000 ORDER BY g.memory_capacity DESC

question: AM4 소켓 CPU 중 6코어 이상인 것
sql: SELECT m.module_id, m.category_id, m.name, m.brand, m.price, m.performance_score, m.image_url FROM modules m JOIN cpus c ON c.module_id = m.module_id WHERE c.socket = 'AM4' AND c.cores >= 6

question: DDR4 램 중 3200MT/s 이상인 제품 싼 순서로
sql: SELECT m.*, r.memory_spec, r.capacity, r.clock, r.package_count FROM modules m JOIN rams r ON r.module_id = m.module_id WHERE r.memory_spec = 'DDR4' AND r.clock >= 3200 ORDER BY m.price ASC

question: Mini-ITX 메인보드 전부 보여줘
sql: SELECT m.*, mb.* FROM modules m JOIN main_boards mb ON mb.module_id = m.module_id WHERE mb.form_factor = 'Mini-ITX'

question: 850W 이상 플래티넘 등급 파워 알려줘
sql: SELECT m.*, p.rated_power, p.certification, p.has_16pin, p.pcie_8pin_count, p.form_factor FROM modules m JOIN power p ON p.module_id = m.module_id WHERE p.rated_power >= 850 AND p.certification = '80PLUS PLATINUM' ORDER BY m.price ASC

question: M.2 SSD 중 쓰기 속도가 가장 빠른 3개
sql: SELECT m.module_id, m.category_id, m.name, m.brand, m.price, m.performance_score, m.image_url, s.write_speed FROM modules m JOIN ssds s ON s.module_id = m.module_id WHERE s.form_factor = 'M.2 2280' ORDER BY s.write_speed DESC LIMIT 3

question: 7200RPM HDD 중 4TB 이상
sql: SELECT m.*, h.* FROM modules m JOIN hdds h ON h.module_id = m.module_id WHERE h.rpm = 7200 AND h.capacity >= 4

question: 32인치 4K 모니터 보여줘
sql: SELECT m.*, mo.screen_size, mo.resolution, mo.panel_type, mo.refresh_rate, mo.aspect_ratio FROM modules m JOIN monitors mo ON mo.module_id = m.module_id WHERE mo.screen_size = 32 AND mo.resolution = '3840x2160' ORDER BY m.price ASC

question: i5-13600K에 맞는 메인보드 중 경고 없는 것
sql: SELECT m.* FROM v_cpu_board_compat v JOIN modules m ON m.module_id = v.board_id LEFT JOIN v_cpu_board_warnings w ON w.cpu_id = v.cpu_id AND w.board_id = v.board_id WHERE v.cpu_id = (SELECT mc.module_id FROM modules mc JOIN cpus c ON c.module_id = mc.module_id WHERE mc.name LIKE '%i5-13600K%' LIMIT 1) AND w.warning_code IS NULL

question: RTX 5070에 충분한 파워 중 가장 싼 3개
sql: SELECT m.module_id, m.category_id, m.name, m.brand, m.price, m.performance_score, m.image_url, p.rated_power, p.certification, p.has_16pin, p.pcie_8pin_count, p.form_factor FROM power p JOIN modules m ON m.module_id = p.module_id WHERE p.module_id IN (SELECT v.power_id FROM v_gpu_power_compat v JOIN graphic_cards g ON g.module_id = v.gpu_id WHERE g.chipset = 'GeForce RTX 5070') ORDER BY m.price ASC LIMIT 3

question: 제조사별 메인보드 평균 가격
sql: SELECT m.brand, AVG(m.price) AS avg_price FROM modules m JOIN main_boards mb ON mb.module_id = m.module_id GROUP BY m.brand
